section.name: TWB Catering
section.description: Full checkout journey for a live commercial catering platform - cart, order creation, real-time inventory sync, and multi-gateway payments.
highlights: Architected end-to-end checkout with Zustand cart state and real-time Supabase inventory sync, reaching a 95%+ checkout completion rate
Integrated Stripe, Noon Payments, Apple Pay, and Google Pay behind a unified layer with consistent error handling and transaction logging
Built SSR/ISR product routing serving 50,000+ monthly product pages
Maintained 90%+ Google Lighthouse scores through Web Vitals monitoring
